author: Dale Philip
description: I visited the Setia Alam Night Market (Pasar Malam Setia Alam) in Selangor Malaysia, which is famously the longest night market in the country. I found this stall selling candied grapes and straweberries on a stick and gave it a go. The nearest thing I can compare it to is a toffee apple, with that crispy sugary glaze around the fruit.
title: Fruit Candy Stick in Selangor, Malaysia 🇲🇾
